newsitem.title: FRANCE: SFS to increase warehousing space at Lyon-Satolas.
newsitem.headline: SFS to increase warehousing space at Lyon-Satolas.

text.p: French cargo handling agent, Societe de Fret et de Services, SFS, said it would be occupying all the warehousing space available in a forthcoming extension to freight installations at Lyon-Satolas.
"We will be taking 2,500 sq metres of space in the extension swelling our stock of warehousing at Lyon to 4,200 sq m," a Lyon-based SFS official told Reuters.
"The need for extra capacity reflects the growing volume of traffic handled by SFS at Lyon and our existing installations are just inadequate," he noted.
Lyon's Chamber of Commerce, the airport's operator, is investing 13 million francs in the extension which is due to enter service early in 1998, an airport authority spokesman said.
The extension, which will take total warehousing capacity at the site to around 30,000 sq m, will also include 1,350 sq m of offices.

SFS also has freight handling centres at the Paris airports, Charles de Gaulle and Orly, and regional airports at Lille and Toulouse. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017 - www.racs.com
